description: A reaction picture (image, or video from videoStart) with its sound, cut to when the sound lands (or seconds): a 1080x1920 clip for post_edit join.

image.description: still picture URL; use this or video

seconds.description: fixed insert length, 0.2 to 6 seconds, instead of when the sound lands

sound.description: sound URL (find_sound returns one), or a video whose own audio is used

soundEnd.description: seconds into the sound where it ends

soundStart.description: seconds into the sound where the insert's sound starts

video.description: video URL to take the picture from, starting at videoStart

videoStart.description: seconds into the video where the insert starts

name: make_insert
title: Make an insert clip
